articles.title: Goldman, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley see tokenization as a growth play, not a threat
articles.snippet: The largest banks in the world are eyeing new trading opportunities, speeding up payments and a role for advisers as tokenization takes root in Wall Street.

articles.title: Citrini sees a tokenization boom. The harder question is who profits
articles.snippet: The influential research firm says real-world assets could finally give blockchains a clear role in finance. For investors, the next challenge is figuring out which companies, networks and protocols capture the revenue.

articles.title: Polygon sees Coinme acquisition as entry to payments sector dominated by Visa, Stripe
articles.snippet: CEO Marc Boiron said the Coinme acquisition will help Polygon control customer relationships and capture revenue that previously went to payment intermediaries.

articles.title: Banks could slow stablecoin growth by paying savers more, BIS paper finds
articles.snippet: A BIS working paper found a 1 basis point rise in U.S. bank deposit rates predicted slower stablecoin growth, cutting ten-week growth from 15% to 12%.

articles.title: ‘Wow, it’s a real discovery’: Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery
articles.snippet: Numbers the spy agency handed over in the 1990s, long suspected of hiding a backdoor, turn out to have come from a basic computer program. Bitcoin was never on that list, and its quantum problem hasn’t gone anywhere.
